audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3, 4-5 and first item were all scored Yorick while the matching whys say you win every one of them — whys[2] 'lets you out-econ him while his single-target ghoul trades can't punish you back', whys[3] 'Your barrel chains zone him off the wave he needs to shove for Maiden', whys[5] 'force the all-in in this window'. Level 1 was scored Gangplank while whys[0] says 'neither side wins the short trade'. The matchup is also labelled TRICKY at 7.5/10 difficulty on a 58.01% win rate.
audit.why: 58.01% over 1017 games is the most favourable lane in this slice: you win from level 2 through your first item and lose only the two-item splitpush. The packet chart (Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Yorick) matches the prose row for row.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled, diff moved from TRICKY to FAV and difficulty from 7.5/10 to 5/10 with the two prose lines that quote the number updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phases named no Yorick ability except Dark Procession, which it repeated on every row.
audit.why: The stage-defining facts are elsewhere: Mourning Mist marks you and speeds his summons toward you, Maiden makes Yorick's own attacks on her target hurt more, and the two-item Maiden plus ghoul wave is what actually flips the lane. None of it was in the full layer.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[3].why, phases[6].why and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions are absent everywhere. (a) Last Rites is an auto-attack reset that also heals him, so his burst tell is the wind-up, not a cast animation. (b) Dark Procession's wall is destructible — Riot's text calls it 'a destructible wall' — yet every line on the page treats being ringed as a hard trap with no answer.
audit.why: Both change what the player does: you step out on the wind-up rather than on a cast, and when ringed you break the nearest wall segment rather than walking the perimeter while ghouls chew on you.
audit.corrected: Auto-reset tell into phases[2].why, destructibility into dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit Q autoReset flag and text

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only as a stock clause in breakdown.late and report[8]; no line says what heals.
audit.why: Last Rites heals Yorick on every cast at 6s falling to 4s, which is precisely why a long fight inside his swarm refills him. That is the reason for Grievous Wounds and it was never stated.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Yorick contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Coin flip at 1: his ghoul gives free last-hits, and your lone keg is low-HP enough for him to walk over and pop.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Yorick's Dark Procession is down.
edits.after: Parrrley-into-keg chips him every step-up, and with no dash at all he cannot slip the detonation slow.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yorick must walk into your range.
edits.after: Last Rites is an auto reset that heals him, so the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast itself.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your barrel chains zone him off the wave he must shove for Maiden. Mourning Mist marks you and speeds his ghouls in — dodge the globule.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen plus a keg chain bursts him through the ghouls before Maiden stacks on you. Force it now.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Yorick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items and Maiden plus a ghoul wave out-splitpush you; Dark Procession walls you in. Group, don't duel him.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Yorick steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Yorick steps to farm, and stay off the keg so his E can't ring you.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Trading inside his ghoul swarm — Mourning Mist speeds them onto you and shreds your armour first.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and destructible — never fight ringed.

edits.before: Yorick wastes Dark Procession (Cage) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Maiden makes his hits harder on her target — kill the wave, not him.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His W wall is destructible: break through it instead of walking the long way.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mourning Mist shreds armour and marks you for every ghoul at once.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Last Rites heals him each cast, so a long swarm fight refills him — bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. You win the lane outright and lose the late — close it before his Maiden splitpush takes over.
